about: The postcommunio of the formulary “12th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the holy reception of this sacrament, we beseech You, O Lord, restore us to life, and bestow upon us forgiveness and protection. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
